name: Archive Extraction Path Traversal (Zip Slip)
attack_scenario: an archive entry named ../../etc/cron.d/x is extracted with its path intact, so unpacking an attacker-supplied archive writes files outside the target directory (zip slip)
negative_test_hint: extract an archive containing an entry named "../../evil.sh" and assert nothing is written outside the destination directory

exemplar.explanation: validate each entry resolves inside the destination before extracting; do not blindly extractall untrusted archives
